*'''Noob''' - Aka '''N00b''' is mostly used in games. It means Internaut who is not new (more than 2 weeks) to something, but still sucks. Frequently confused with Newbie. Antonym of Pro.
*'''Off-Topic''' - Something (a message, a page, an email) that is not on topic. (Example: Some Internaut asks how to choose colors that are colorblind-friendly, and everyone responds by talking about choosing colors, while one Internaut brings up Graham's number. In that case, the Internaut talking about Graham's number is off-topic.)
*'''Pop-Up''' - Annoying thing in [[Pageverse]] that pops up. Can be blocked by Add-Ons.
*'''Pro''' - Short for: professionalist. Means Internaut very good at something. Antonym of Noob.
*'''REKO''' - Short for: recommendations of something.
*'''Rickroll''' - See Trolling section.
*'''ROFL''' - Rolling On the Floor Laughing. Means something even funnier than LOL.
*'''Screamer''' - See Trolling section.
*'''SEO''' - Short for: Search Engine Optimization. Practice of improving a Websiteverse so it ranks higher in SearchEngineverse navigation.
*'''Spam''' - "Spam" is a term used to describe ads or messages like "spam spam spam," but where "spam" (or another word) is repeated SIGNIFICANTLY more times. If you still don't understand, see [[Spamverse]] '''(WARNING: SPAMVERSE IS OVER 100 KB!)'''.
*'''Tank''' - Mostly used in games. Someone in games designed to take hits and protect weaker teammates; literally tank (armored vehicle).
*'''Toxic''' - A Toxic Internaut is someone who is very hostile toward other Internauts: they engage in cyberbullying, trolling, and/or hate speech. A Troll is a subset of a Toxic Internaut. The term Toxic comes from the fact that such Internauts "poison" the lives of other Internauts, and when they’re really angry, they might start tormenting someone else, so it spreads like a real plague. '''Toxic Internauts get banned for this, which is why we do not promote being toxic, and we do not assume any responsibility for mistakes.'''
*'''Trolling''' - See Trolling section.
*'''TTYL''' - Short for: Talk To You Later. Commonly used in chat.
*'''Viral''' - Viral refers to a video, meme, or something else from the SocialMediaverse that has gained instant popularity and is being shared with millions of Internauts.
*'''WIP''' - WIP stands for Work In Progress (something unfinished yet).

==REAL Rules of Internetverse (Netiquette)==
Unlike the "Rules" of the Internetverse, which were mostly just nonsense, '''these rules are real and should be followed (seriously).''' These rules are universal, so some Websiteverses may have their own. For clarity, these rules are not numbered; they can be listed in any order, but for convenience, they will be numbered here.

List:
#'''Don't spam.''' If you don't know what spam is, check out [[Spamverse]], which is a good example of it. '''(WARNING: SPAMVERSE IS OVER 100 KB!)'''
##'''Don't chain message. This means you shouldn't create it or forward it if some Internaut sends it to you.''' Chain message is a message that tells you to forward it. It might be a simple request, or it might be a message that threatens you to forward it, saying that if you don’t, something bad will happen to you (a punishment). Or the opposite: it might say that if you forward it, something good will happen (a reward). Or both (a punishment and a reward). To be clear, '''nothing good or bad will happen because of this message, and messages like this just clutter up inbox/E-Mail and are a form of spam.'''
#When you send a message/post, give it a subject line.
##'''Do not write the message content in the subject line.''' Enter the subject in the subject line, and enter the message in the message field.
#'''Write in a way that is easy to understand.''' What this means is that if you have a choice between an easy word and a very obscure and complicated one, choose the easy one. Of course, words used in the niche you're discussing are welcome.
##'''Write in the appropriate language.''' In other words, if the community is English-speaking, write in English.
##'''Don't make grammatical mistakes.''' It's not about becoming someone who nitpicks whether you capitalize “I” or not; it's about avoiding glaring mistakes, like adding the -ed ending to an irregular verb.
##'''Do not use profanity.''' The exception is when the situation actually calls for it and the profanity is mild.
##'''Use paragraphs.''' They make reading much easier.
##'''The text should contain a lot of information, not just be long.''' Of course, it can be long and contain A LOT of information (like this article, for example).
#'''Don't type your entire message in ALL CAPS.''' It looks ugly and makes it hard to read. It's best not to use CAPS LOCK at all, or to use it very sparingly.
#'''Don't insult others or do things that might provoke someone.''' In other words, don't use offensive words when talking about someone. You should speak politely.
#'''Don't overuse emojis.''' They are ONLY an add-on, not something essential. This is especially important right now, since AI uses emojis excessively, so if you use them, other Internauts might think that AI is writing for you.
#'''Don't share other Internaut's private information.''' Nothing ever disappears from the Internetverse.
##'''The exception is when this data is publicly available.''' In that case, you may distribute it.
#'''Don't vandalize or troll.''' That's the fastest way to get banned.
#'''Respect copyright laws.''' A certain [[Wikiverse]] couldn't care less about them, and it's only a matter of time before someone files a complaint against it.
#'''Always check whether the information is true or if it's fake news''', especially if you want to share it. Many Internauts don't do this, and end up spreading lies.
#'''Be careful with links that Internauts send you.''' They could be a rickroll or a screamer, or, in the worst case, a [[Pageverse]] containing [[Virusverse]]s.
#'''Before you ask a question, check to see if it has already been asked many times before.''' This is a common mistake on Redditverse that results in the same question being asked hundreds of times - completely unnecessarily.
#'''Stay on topic.''' This means don't post off-topic comments/replies.
#'''Avoid unnecessary pings.''' The point is not to use “@” unless it's very important and urgent.

==Bots==
Bots are robots with scripts that enable them to perform simple tasks. They are very helpful in automating the Internetverse, but some of them are bad. Half of the traffic on the Internetverse comes from Bots. Here are some types of Bots:
*'''Good Bots'''
**'''Crawlers/Spiders''' - Bots that crawl links for various purposes. They may do this to archive [[Pageverse]] to WaybackMachineverse, to help organize [[Pageverse]]s, or to collect data for AI (see AI section).
**'''Monitoring Bots''' - Bots that test a Websiteverse/[[Pageverse]]'s performance, speed, click-through rate, and vulnerability to [[Virusverse]]s and hackers.
**'''Shopping Bots''' - Bots that check prices (from entire Internetverse or selected Websiteverses) and select the best ones for the buyer.
**'''Social Media Management Bots''' - Bots that do a lot on social media<ref>See Websiteverses>Types of Websiteverses section</ref>. They can post at specific times, remove inappropriate content, or scan messages to replace text with a link.
*'''Bad Bots'''
**'''Spam Bots''' - Bots that operate in every corner of the Internetverse, spamming messages—whether they're nonsense like “1111111<ref>But MUCH longer.</ref>”, a meaningful (but not necessarily true) sentence like “Hello world,” or something harmful, such as a link to a rickroll or screamer.
**'''Credential Stuffing/Account Takeover Bots''' - Bots used by hackers to break into someone's account. They do this by stealing passwords. They do this to take over someone's account.
**'''DDoS Bots''' - Bots that control [[Virusverse]]s, which force an infected Deviceverse to send a large number of messages or significantly increase traffic in order to destroy or block a Websiteverse.
**'''Scalper and Sneaker Bots''' - Bots designed to quickly buy limited-edition items—either out of pure malice, to obtain those items for the bot-controlling Internaut's own use, or to resell them later at a very high price.
**'''Web Scrapers''' - Bots that are very similar to Crawlers/Spiders, but with malicious intent. They do not crawl Websiteverses for legitimate purposes. Instead, they steal Websiteverse content against the Websiteverse owner’s will. They may do this to steal valuable data, feed that data to AI while disregarding copyright laws, or for some other purpose.
**'''Click Fraud Bots''' - Bots that view ads to generate revenue for the Websiteverse owner, even though no Internaut has seen them, or to spite the advertisers (since they spent money on the ad, but it failed to convince anyone)

==AI==
Short for Artificial Intelligence. These are Robots that are much smarter than Bots. They work in a fairly complex way, but it's explained in one of these videos:
*https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aircAruvnKk&list=PLZHQObOWTQDNU6R1_67000Dx_ZCJB-3pi

===Types of AI by Intelligence===
====ANI====
{{Quote|quotetext=Sometimes referred to as Weak AI, Artificial Narrow Intelligence is AI that specializes in one area. There’s AI that can beat the world chess champion in chess, but that’s the only thing it does. Ask it to figure out a better way to store data on a hard drive, and it’ll look at you blankly.|personquoted=https://waitbutwhy.com/2015/01/artificial-intelligence-revolution-1.html}}
'''Short for Artificial Narrow Intelligence''' - ANI is an AI that specializes in only one field and can't do anything in other fields. This means it's better than Internaut in only one thing, but it completely sucks at everything else.
====AGI====
{{Quote|quotetext=Sometimes referred to as Strong AI, or Human-Level AI, Artificial General Intelligence refers to a computer that is as smart as a human across the board—a machine that can perform any intellectual task that a human being can.|personquoted=https://waitbutwhy.com/2015/01/artificial-intelligence-revolution-1.html}}
'''Short for Artificial General Intelligence''' - AGI is an AI that specializes in many fields. It's as intelligent as Internaut. '''For now, we're somewhere between ANI and AGI (we're in a transition phase).'''
====ASI====
{{Quote|quotetext=An intellect that is much smarter than the best human brains in practically every field, including scientific creativity, general wisdom and social skills.|personquoted=Nick Bostrom}}
'''Short for Artificial Superintelligence''' - ASI is an AI that specializes in all fields. It is smarter than Internaut; it might only be 10% smarter, or the difference could be as great as that between an ant and a [[human]] — except that Internaut is the "ant", and ASI is the "[[human]]."

==Trolling==
===Bait-and-switch Media===
{{Quote|quotetext=Bait-and-switch Media refers to various trolling pictures and videos that trick a user into viewing unexpected content, usually through fake linking, misleading thumbnails or titles and other duping techniques.|personquoted=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/bait-and-switch-media}}
Examples of Bait-and-switch Media:
*'''Rickroll''' - Extremely common type of trolling. Rickroll described from Rickroll Fighters perspective: "A rickroll is a URL that looks like a normal link to YouTubeverse — because it actually is one — but it’s not normal. It’s something that disrupts the Internauts experience and presents unconventional audiovisual content. It’s such a widespread and serious phenomenon that a group has been formed to combat it - we, the Rickroll Fighters (see Rickroll Fighters section). Fortunately, you can protect yourself from Rickrolling using add-ons (there’s a separate section for add-ons)."
*'''Screamer''' - Other (but less common<ref>Screamer is probably used less often because it’s much harder to set up as it requires finding an effective video source rather than deploying a single, well-known link.</ref>) type of trolling. It’s quite similar to a Rickroll, because it also works by using a URL to the YouTubeverse (or other SocialMediaverse). Unlike a Rickroll, it’s much harder to protect yourself from it, because there aren’t just a few links to the same video. Screamer is a term for a video designed to startle or frighten the viewer upon activation. The Silenters fight with Screamer (see The Silenters section). Unlike a Rickroll, a Screamer doesn't troll you right away. At first, it makes you focus on the screen (for example, by showing a maze), and then it displays a scary image and a loud scream. First Screamer was Kikia.

Interestingly, they don't attack trolls who don't use rickroll, even though those trolls are also really bad. The Rickroll Fighters are curious to know who to blame for the rickroll. They know you can’t blame the person who created the SONG, but rather the person who turned that song into trolling. Unlike the Rickroll Fighters, The Silenters know who to blame — they blame Netspooky, the creator of Kikia, the first Screamer. === Projections ===
[https://www.eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=41433 EIA projects nearly 50% increase in world energy usage by 2050]. This is about 29 TW which approaches 0.75 on the Kardashev scale in 2050. The exponential nature of the scale should not be underestimated. To get from Type 0.73 to Type 1 requires 500 times more energy. Every decimal point on the scale is 1000 times more than the previous. The difference between the start of Type 1 and the start of Type 2 is at least a billion times more. Massive increases in energy usage, technology and the multiplicative nature of having many home planets would contribute to moving up the scale. This is made more difficult by efficient usage of energy the more advanced a civilization gets.

[https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-023-38351-y This paper] suggests that if [[nuclear fusion]] is achieved, which is an energy and [[Industrial Revolution|industrial revolution]], we are expected to reach Type 0.77 by the end of the twenty-first century. However, if the current energy structure does not change, and the human civilization follows its current trend, we will only reach Type 0.75 by the end of the twenty-first century.

[[Freeman Dyson]] calculated in 1959 that if mankind's Malthusian (exponential) growth rate in energy consumption were to continue, the human race would reach a crisis point within the next two to three millennia. At this point, all the non-renewable sources would be exhausted, and even renewable sources exploited on a planet-wide scale would be unable to cope with further demand. To provide for future growth, the human race will need to capture much more of the [[Sun|Sun's]] light with a [[Dyson sphere]].

[[Michio Kaku]] suggested that if humans increase their energy consumption at an average rate of 3% each year, they may attain [[Type 1]] status in 100–200 years, [[Type 1]] status in a few thousand years, and [[Type 3]] status in 100,000 to a million years. Kaku and others proposed extensions of the scale for [[Type 4]] onwards. This varies between superclusters and the universe for IV, various levels of the multiverse for V, and godly universe-creators and matter manipulators for VI. We try to define this more carefully based on the [[infinity map]].

=== Criticisms ===

==== Entropy and energy efficiency ====
An [[entropy]] limiting factor should also be considered in an adjustment to the scale. An advanced civilization will be able to perform vastly more tasks with less energy than we use today, and far less wastage due to friction. This was evident from 1920 to 1970 where the K-rating increased more rapidly than from 1970 onwards where we became more energy-efficient. One example is the [[transistor]] and die-shrink scaling. We are able to perform magnitudes more compute with magnitudes less energy usage. Another example is the electric car, which can go a lot faster than cars with [[Combustion engine|combustion engines]], using less energy. Energy efficiency is also important for [[transistor]] cooling and reducing die-cast sizes.

==== Landauer's principle ====
Another consideration for energy efficiency is [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Landauer%27s_principle Landauer's principle], pertaining to the lower theoretical limit of energy consumption of computation which is approximately 0.018 eV (2.9×10<sup>−21</sup> J). Modern computers use about a billion times as much energy per operation, which means they can get more efficient by 9 orders of magnitude using [[Nanotechnology|nanomechanical]] [[computronium]]. In the far future a [[Matrioshka brain]] could get even more efficient using a [[Carnot engine]]. This is a setback and even a criticism of the Kardashev scale, and so to truly scale exponentially, one would have to consider a much higher multiplicative number of colonies across vast distances.

==== What are we able to do with 1 kg of matter? ====

* Burning that amount of fuel (oil/gas/coal) gives you the lowest amounts of energy in [[Fossil fuel power station|fossil fuel power stations]] or [[Oil refinery|oil refineries]].
* Nuclear fission would release more energy, and nuclear fusion even more, at the subatomic level in [[Nuclear power station|nuclear power stations]].
* In the future, we will be able to release far more energy at the elementary or fundamental level, tearing quarks apart in [[Quark reactor|quark reactors]]. 
* An [[antimatter engine]] would be 300 times more powerful than nuclear fusion.
* We will be able to harness [[Zero-point energy|zero-point-energy]], such that 1kg of matter could be used to boil all the world's oceans.

So the K-scale needs an update from "primary energy not engineered" to engineered primary energy. What we are ''doing'' with available energy should give us a higher rating.

==== A pessimistic estimate from [http://www.xenology.info/Xeno/15.1.htm Xenology] ====
If the historical 3% growth rate is maintained, then by the year 2300 mankind's energy budget will be up to 2 x 10<sup>17</sup> W, which is also the total power received from from the Sun to Earth. We will then face the most critical "energy crisis" in the history of Earth. All forms of energy (electrical, thermal, mechanical, nuclear) ultimately returns to the biosphere as ''heat'', causing the global temperature to rise and the precarious energy balance of the biosphere begins to suffer irreversible damage. By the time artificial energy production equals total solar influx, the planet will have suffered serious ecological damage. Earth would no longer be inhabitable by humans, our lush green world converted into a stewing, steamy hellhole like Venus. 

A safe level is likely the photosynthetic energy limit, or the total solar energy used by green plants worldwide which is about 4 x 10<sup>13</sup> W. Using 1% of the total solar influx (10<sup>15</sup> W) would be a critical limit, sufficient to melt the polar icecaps and thoroughly disrupt the entire ecology. 

''"We estimate, therefore, that the maximum upper limit of artificial energy generation for any [[Type 1]] planetary culture limited to a single world in our galaxy is roughly 10<sup>15</sup> watts".''

=== Roman numerals ===
From this [https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290995474_Kardashev's_Classification_at_50_A_Fine_Vehicle_with_Room_for_Improvement research paper], the author made a note: "I shall use Arabic numerals for Kardashev’s types throughout this study, although it is a historical fact that Kardashev, and indeed most subsequent authors, used Roman numerals. Apart from the latter being outdated in general, I have two justiﬁcations speciﬁc to the problem at hand: (i) Arabic numeration enables natural introduction of fractional subtypes, like Type 2.5 civilization, etc. which was already a problem for Carl Sagan in 1970s; and (ii) there is no Roman numeral for zero, while it seems logically natural to introduce Type 0 civilization (and its fractional successors) as the pre-technological state of any intelligent community."

There has been a shift in how the Kardashev scale is represented, with many contemporary researchers advocating for '''Arabic numerals or decimals''' (e.g., Type 1.0, 2.0, 3.0) instead of the traditional '''Roman numerals''' (Type I, II, III). This change facilitates greater precision and accommodates fractional values, which are useful for indicating incremental progress between civilization types.

==== Why use Arabic numerals? ====

* '''Precision''': Arabic numerals allow for decimal values, enabling more nuanced classifications. For instance, Carl Sagan estimated that Earth was at approximately Type 0.7 in the 1970s, and more recent assessments place us around Type 0.73.​
* '''Scalability''': The extended Kardashev scale includes additional types beyond the original three, such as Type 0.0 (biological) up to Type 4.0 (universal), corresponding to energy production levels from 10⁶ to 10⁴⁶ watts. This extension is more naturally expressed with Arabic numerals.​
* '''Clarity''': Using Arabic numerals helps avoid confusion, especially when discussing fractional types or when integrating the scale into mathematical models and equations.
This wiki aims to be scientifically accurate and reflect current thinking, and support fine-grained classifications (like Type 0.72 or 2.5). We also want to appeal to readers who are used to seeing decimal-based Kardashev scales in modern papers, YouTube explainers, and sci-fi discussions. Therefore the decision was made to move away from Roman numerals to decimals.

A '''''Life universe''''' is a fictional [[Universe]], where everything lives, either in a ''fairy-tale way'', or via the laws of said Universe being so complex, that all non-organic matter becomes organic.

The '''Life universe''' is only a thought experiment, but since its the opposite of the [[Death universe]], which has no life, it has a few variants as to what ''"everything is living"'' means.

The first kind of '''Life universe''', is one that can and does, ''actually exist''. The laws of such verses are complex, varied and expansive enough, as to allow life formation at ''any and all scales'', from most ''any materials''. These verses are '''unbelievably rare''', but most known are naturally made and not artificial, as they are sometimes too difficult to even construct.

The second type is a fairy tale version of the '''Life universe''', a fiction which has existed throughout our ''(mankind's)'' history, and that is a variant, where everything that can be labeled and is large enough to be seen with the naked eye, is alive. Things like water, rocks, tools, fingers, mountains, clouds, etc.

A third and much more absolute and literal version of the '''Life universe''', is one where literally everything is alive. The particles, time, space, ''the Universe itself too''.

A fourth but much less popular version, is one where every single subset of a Universe is living. This theoretically would include as many living beings as possible, and can be called an '''excessive life universe'''.

When a '''Life universe''' collides with a Death universe, they together create a "normal universe". This definition is purposefully arbitrary as to what it means. This usually means a Universe with some average lifeforms that may grow advanced one day, but that would create an inbalance between the Life and Death universes, with a dowside for the Death universe.

Themselves, [[Mandelbrothsoup]]s}}The '''''Mandelbrothverses''''' are cosmic structures with surprisingly high stability for their size and types of [[Verse|verses]] within them. They're home to almost all verses with any sort of [[:Category:Fractal|fractal]] theme below their size, including themselves and [[Mandelbrothsoup|Mandelbrothsoups]]. Another notable thing they contain are extremely large pools of a broth-like [[:Category:Substance|substance]] scattered around their space.

== Self Containment ==
The Mandelbrothverses, although not fractal structures, are [[:Category:Berry Paradox|self-containing]] ones to match their name and nature of the Mandel- prefix. All layers of containment within them hold broth bubbles and fractally based structures, and of course many of the previous layer. They actually only grow a finite amount of the previous iteration's diameter. This [[:Category:Number|number]] ranges anywhere from 100 - 200000x the size, but ALWAYS averages out at 4571x/iteration over all of the containers.

== Broth ==
As its namesake, the Mandelbrothverses hold large amounts of broth-like substance in their [[Void|voids]], making up about 10% of the mass of the object in all iterations on average. It's been heavily studied and tested in multiple environments, and it seems to be a tasteless, light brown [[:Category:Liquid|liquid]] with no negative or positive features. No use as fuel, [[:Category:Cosmic Food|food]], or any other thing a liquid can serve as. It doesn't even have a texture we associate with matter, but is still mallable and existent.

It concerns the question of what it means that something is possible or necessary. Modal realism is the view that besides the actual world, there are many possible worlds. They exist as alternate versions of the actual world we live in. It contrasts with actualism, which holds that there is only one world: the actual world. Extended modal realism is a special form of modal realism. It includes the controversial thesis that there are not just possible worlds but also impossible worlds. An impossible world is a world that contains a contradiction. Extended modal realism understands modality as a dimension similar to space and time. In this sense, a regular object, like a tree or a car, is not just extended in space and time but also across possible and impossible worlds: some parts of it exist in the actual world and other parts exist in non-actual worlds. There is only one universe encompassing everything that is real in the widest sense: the actual, the possible, and the impossible. he modal stage of the tree in the actual world is nowhere violet but it has violet parts at other modal indices. The tree as a whole is a modally extended entity encompassing not just the actual tree but also all its modal parts belonging to other worlds. Like in Lewis's modal realism, the term actual just has an indexical meaning: it refers to the modal index of the speaker. Actual is thus analogous to the spatial term here and the temporal term now.

Bright Matter}}The '''Negativerse''' is a newly discovered parallel realm located at the exact center of our universe, and after years of observation and research, astronomers concluded that it closely resembles our own universe, but many of its physical properties exist in an inverted or "negative" state. Matter, energy, and even certain natural laws behave in ways that often appear to contradict those of normal space.

Despite its hostile environment, the Negativerse is not completely uninhabitable. With sufficiently advanced protective equipment and life-support systems, explorers can survive and even conduct research within it for extended periods.

The Negativerse is also inherently paradoxical. Many of its phenomena violate logic and physics, allowing impossible events to occur without apparent contradiction. Objects may somehow simultaneously possess opposing properties, and cause-and-effect relationships can behave unpredictably, making the realm one of the most mysterious locations ever discovered.

== Things that are negative in the Negativerse ==

* '''Negative Gravity:''' Gravity works differently, possibly causing objects to repel instead of attract.
* '''Negative Physics:''' Some physical laws operate in reversed ways compared to normal physics.
* '''Negative Logic:''' Certain events and situations do not follow normal rules, allowing contradictions to exist.
* '''Negative Existence:''' The Negativerse itself has unusual properties that make its existence partially paradoxical.
* '''Negative Planets:''' Planets within the Negativerse have reversed characteristics, with their structures and behaviors differing from normal planets.
* '''Negative Mass:''' Some objects may have a form of inverted mass, causing them to behave differently when affected by forces.

A '''''Nebulon bubble''''' is a dense sphere-like [[verse]] known for its chaotic nature. These verses consist of tangled webs of ever-changing [[String|strings]] that are also in constant movement. This remains in the shape of a sphere somehow. 

== Layers ==

===Nebulon void===
The outermost layer is sometimes known as the edge or the Nebulon void; it's a dense cloud of matter surrounding the main '''Nebulon bubble'''.

===Outer Nebulon bubble===
The outer layer is a thin layer of a '''Nebulon bubble'''. It is already way denser than the Nebulon void. From this point, you are considered to be inside the Nebulon bubble itself and not just its surroundings.

===Inner Nebulon bubble===
The Inner Nebulon Bubble is the innermost layer of a '''Nebulon bubble'''.

==Entering and exiting==
Entering a Nebulon bubble is like trying to enter a brown dwarf star. It's possible, but hard.

The '''NULLverses''' are the [[universe|universes]] of error. They are made up of the [[Endlessradioactive Elements|extreme glitchonicite]] [[:Category:Elements|element]], which makes these [[Verse|verses]] unstable, though verses that contain NULLverses are so large they end up somewhat cancelling the glitchiness of the element. Example: They can sometimes affect a [[Fake Pageverse]] on a very small scale. In fact, they are so small that these affects are completely null for the latters.  

However, if these verses never existed, then larger verses may not even be able to form as they serve to balance their stability. 

If something or someone touches the barriers of this type of verse with enough force, it could create an explosion able of destroying everything within the diameter of a [[Primordial String]] at any time.  

There are, of course different types of NULLverses. Most are normal with their glitches but some special variants could even be considered as anti-versions of NULLverses. In other cases, they might be so much more glichier which sometimes could end up making them self-destruct and spread their remains over their entire local [[ERRORverse|ERRORverses]].  

== Effects ==
There are, of course, no major destructions to verses like the Fake Pageverses and above. NULLverses are too small to do this as their maximum capacity can only make some things in the larger structures to move or get distorted in a very slight way.

If we are talking about smaller things like ERRORverses, then the effects can depend on which NULLverse type it is. At times, when a NULLverse is so corrupted it can affect its neighborhoods and maybe even their ERRORverse. There can be deposits of leftover matter when a NULLverse dies, which are like [[Star|stars]] dying and turning into nebulae. Those deposits can still make glitches, but in a smaller scale.

A ''Nultiverse''<ref>Nulti is a prefix between Uni and Multi.</ref> is a weak structure of parallel [[Universe|Universes]] contained entirely within multi-dimensional space. It is formed via the random production of infinitesimal particles in an empty infinite space, and their evolution into Universes.

As with other similar clusters, Nultiverses can exist separately to the standard [[Archverse|Archverses]], if the diameter exceeds the available length in a [[Multiverse]]. Nultiverses are also less difficult to produce artificially within an advanced civilization.

==Separation==
The parallel universes within a Nultiverse are separated on all physical levels; a set of perfectly identical Universes would merge via gravitational force.

Examples of dividers:
* Distance to counter gravity
* Different [[Uqraek fiber]] to counter subatomic interaction
* Temporal distance to counter standard physical interaction 


Our Nultiverse is NULTI-01

==Appearance==
'''''Normals''''' are very light gray balls with eight limbs, which are light gray and not red. Their hind limbs are not darker than their front ones. Their eyes are just like humans', except that they don't have a palpebral fissure, which means the eyes look exactly as they actually do. Their faces... are just like in cartoons. They all have a "dark gray rectangle" on the front - it is empty, indicating the absence of any prefixes (see the Technical section). At the top, each has "10^0". (look for the [[Normal#Technical|Technical section]]).

==Technical==
*It says "10^0" because one meter, or one gram, or whatever else, is ONE, and 10^0 = 1.
*They don't have prefix beacuse prefixes scale a unit up or down. As said before 10^0 = 1, which means multiplying by 1, leaving the base unit unchanged. It's best to just look at the table of SI prefixes.
*They have the same gender distribution as [[Human]]s, meaning 50/50. (From the [[Human]] page: "have two biological sexes, male and female.")
*Biological density: 1 individual per 149 m^2 (Considering that Normals are balls with one meter in diameter and weigh ~520 kg, that's a very high)

==Alliance==
Normals' civilization belongs to the Metric System. They are one of the prefixes, or rather the absence thereof. Even though there are many civilizations in the Metric System, they have all belonged to the [[:Category:Alliance|alliance]] from the very beginning. It is a massive alliance with one main goal—to eliminate all non-metric systems—and one main enemy—the [[Imperial System]]. For now, they have the upper hand—they control 95% of [[Earth]]!

This alliance ([[Metric System]]) includes, among others, the following Species:
*Prefixes, e.g., [[Kilo (Entity)]], [[Mega (Entity)]], [[Milli (Entity)]]
*Units, e.g., [[Meter (Entity)]], [[Joule (Entity)]], [[Gram (Entity)]]
The Normals' civilization belongs to the prefixes, although they are not prefixes themselves (they simply denote the absence of prefixes)

==War==
'''''<small>AND ONCE AGAIN, THIS SITE IS NOT INTENDED TO OFFEND THE IMPERIAL SYSTEM—THERE ARE OTHER ENTITIES THAT BELONG TO THE IMPERIAL SYSTEM. IT IS SIMPLY A FACT THAT ENTITIES OF THE METRIC SYSTEM ARE IN CONFLICT WITH ENTITIES OF THE IMPERIAL SYSTEM. THE FACT THAT THEY HAVE TAKEN OVER 95% IS ALSO A FACT (95% OF PEOPLE USE THE METRIC SYSTEM).</small>''''' 

According to the Metric System, the Imperial System is very annoying (just take a look at the conversion table for imperial units), so they all decided to tackle this and introduce the simplest possible relationships—multiplying by 10. Since everyone in this story uses the base-10 system, this just means shifting the digits. Because of these events, the Imperial System controls only 5% of the [[Earth]], though it is putting up fierce resistance.

Their activities include, among other things:
*Arguing that switching from the Imperial system to the Metric system would mean an end to unit conversions and faster communication.
*Teaching children the Metric system so they are familiar with it from an early age.
*Pointing out that since everyone in this story uses base-10, and the metric system is based on multiplying by 10, this would simply involve changing the position of the digits.

==Lore (SPOILERS)==
<tabber> Closed=Click open to view this section. Spoilers are present, so beware!

|-|Open='''WARNING: THIS STORY IS A PARODY OF WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED. IT IS NOT INTENDED TO OFFEND ANYONE OR ANYTHING.'''

The story begins innocently enough, with everyone from Weko to Weka living in this world (this isn’t a mistake—keep reading). But everything changed on November 18, 2022. On that day, in Versailles, France, the CGPM forced many beings to change their names. Wekos had to change their names to Quectos, Xennos had to change their names to Rontos, Xennas to Ronnas, and Wekas to Quettas.

They really DIDN'T like the name change. They wanted to take revenge on whoever gave them these new names, but they had no way to do so because they were either extremely small or extremely large. That's why they had to keep it bottled up inside, which led to their corruption. The corruption spread to other prefixes, including the Normals, which aren't actually a prefix.

And since the Normals are already a fairly normal size, they were supposed to fight this “name-caller.” But here’s the problem: they didn’t know who had given those names. So they decided to force people to argue about it. (The part of the story about the arguments is actually true, as can be seen in the example of [[Ronnaverse]]). These arguments were unbearable, so many people decided to do something about it.

FICTIONAL CONTINUATION: That is why many people founded a company intended to restore the old names. They managed to convince the CGPM by showing them what they had done (meaning those argues). They also showed that instead of using English letters, they could use Greek ones (as in the prefix [[Micro]]). Unfortunately, the corruption remained. That's why the player (according to the game's lore) is tasked with uncorrupting all the prefixes.

THE REAL CONTINUATION: Unfortunately, no company has been established, and arguments (+unwanted names) continue :/.

It is also a source of obamite as it can create infinite amounts of obamite and obamite clusters every nanosecond from '''NOTHING.'''  Obamite, however, is very dangerous and so unstable that it can explode if you touch it. It also produces roughly 100 Boxes of obamium every [[Voidsecond]],<ref>It makes more now.</ref> and produces another obamaverse every 7 <s>hours</s> too fast to measure anymore. ==Obamium==
Obamium is an incredibly versatile and powerful substance that can decay into useful crystals that can make anything. Pure obamium and isotopes of it is/are incredibly dangerous but can be utilized by most kardashev scale 11+ civilizations to make very useful and powerful things that can easily speed up the progress of said civilizations. There are also hundreds of similar elements to obamium that can be used in similar ways, but are far more radioactive and are harder and more dangerous to use. Outside of the obama field, it can be expected that there are around 1-2 atoms (of obamium / related elements) per [[The blade|blade]] sized area.

===obamium is alive===
There are actually many living isotopes of obamium. That is all.

== Appearance==
The appearance of the Obamaverse is a big, blue sphere. It also glows a bright red, even though the color of it is blue. The reason for that is because the color of ''solid ''Obamium is blue. The color of Obamium in its ''gas ''state is red. The Obamaverse also is slightly translucent. The obamaverse used to glow reddish brown due to all of the liquid and gas obamium bottling up on the outside for unknown reasons but eventually that spread out and expanded causing it to no longer appear reddish brown and now it is blue from the outside. 

===From outside the obama field ===
From outside of the obama field, the verse actually still appears reddish brown if you have good enough eyes / have a super good telescope, but since the obama field is so much larger than the obamaverse, being outside of the obama field means you can't see the obamaverse.

==Structure==
The Obamaverse is divided into an uncountably infinite number of layers. These layers get thinner and thinner the deeper you go into the Obamaverse. Each layer holds a certain type of verse, just like how [[The Too Big]]'s rings hold a certain type of verse/reality/void. All of the cosmic objects like the planets and stars are usually kept in the middle layers. At the center of the Obamaverse, there is a singularity that acts like a black hole. Anyone who hates Obama will be pulled into it. So far, exactly 1,209 creatures have met their fates in the singularity. The surface of the Obamaverse is also extremely hot due to many Obama stars and nebulas being born in this layer. In the center of the singularity, which is negative sized, continues a larger negative intangible "fake" Obamaverse that is far larger than the "real" obamaverse. No one has entered the fake obamaverse because everyone who tries to get to the singularity gets repelled or teleported back.   

===Structure of the obama field===
The obama field is also made of layers, but a lot more layers and the main difference between layers is that inner layers are more concentrated and thicker. The structure of the obama field is, however, not that simple, as the structure of the obama field is literally impossible to fully describe on fandom because the servers are too small.

===Complexes===
Complexes are areas that form inside of the obamaverse as well as the obama field that are a result of obamium tearing apart the metaphorical and literal fabric of reality, often from particles getting wedged inside of eachother and changing existence ranks and finality indexes simultaneously. Complexes lead to copies of the obamaverse which suck in non-Obamium Related matter / antimatter / quasimatter etc. into versions of the obamaverse that have different properties and existence ranks. These complexes can also lead to themselves and through themselves or even back into the "normal" obamaverse / field and can result in an infinite loop of teleportation. While some complexes can slowly dissipate over time, others can grow larger up until a certain point or just stay forever. Obamians regularly use complex clearing devices to destroy complex "teleportals" to prevent trapping<ref>trapping altdef: getting sucked into a complex and becoming trapped forever</ref>

===Warpers===
Warpers exist in lower layers of the obamaverse that prevent entities and objects from entering the singularity. At first there were no warpers but tourists kept falling into the singularity and fucking dying so obama decided to place a sphere of warpers that teleport people away from the singularity because he didn't want stupid tourists to keep killing themselves because that was cutting into their revenue (and he also didn't like the fact that tourists kept killing themselves among other things).

===Tradiols===
Tradiols do not exist within the obamaverse but exist within a parallel dimension that takes the place of the obamaverse but have small amounts of life and can't be entered from other dimensions without a specific device that there are only 60,000 of. Tradiols can be used to harvest extra obamium in case supply manages to somehow run out. Tradiols have an endless void around the obamaverse in those parallel dimensions because there is no obama field.

=== Rods and Tunnels===
Rods and Tunnels form inside of the obamaverse in [[Protoverse]] sized balls that are floating around the obamaverse at infinite speeds. These rods and tunnels are around the size of [[The Box]] but they are condensed down into null. These rods and tunnels are formed entirely out of obamium, and can occasionally cause the super tiny ball to temporarily collapse and result in it being spewed out in a random direction at infinite speeds. The rods and tunnels are distinctly different from eachother because:

# If a rod exists in a ball, no tunnels will exist in the same ball.
# If a tunnel exists in a ball, no rods will exist in the ball.
# Tunnels have corners. Rods do not have corners.
#Tunnels are blue. Rods are red. Obamites are purple and so are you.

Rods and tunnels can enter Folds and condense back down to the size of a ball, eventually becoming a ball over trillions of [[OYC]]. Balls have mass. Balls will not turn back into rods or tunnels. An infinite amount of rods OR tunnels can exist in a ball at the same time.

===The Obama Ring(s)===
There are obama rings that form in the obama field and obamaverse that can redirect particles and teleport them instantly. This creates a pseudo void inside of the ring where there is little to no matter at all. These obama rings come in multiple different types lmao. The most common, the obamium rings, will simply change the trajectory of particles and/or teleport them to another location in the obamaverse. On all rings there is writing on the edges to give information about the trajectory change on specific particles as well as the location that they teleport to and the distance from the ring. There are also quasobamite rings which change the properties and structure of particles. There are also surrounding rings that surround the obamaverse and the obama field. The obama field ring is constantly expanding to keep up with the everchanging size of the obama field.

=== Obusi ===
Obusi are extremely weird non-euclidean labyrinths full of tunnels that are almost impossible to navigate, as navigation technology, like most technology, glitches out in these. They are also infinitely large, and on the outside appear entirely as obama faces. On the inside, they are very colorful. There are some entities in Obusi. It is unknown how they form, but there have been ideas. One of the most popular ideas is that it is a disconnected level of the backrooms.

===Obama Planets===
There are many obama planets flying around in the obama field. In fact, there are many verses, stars, etc. in the obama field. These obama planets, however, are rogue obama planets travelling at extremely fast speeds, orbiting around the center of the obamaverse.

===O-O===
O-O are infinitely recurring, nested obama crystals that formed in such a powerful collision that they got scattered across spacetime itself, causing copies of them to form throughout the obamaverse and the obama field. They are mostly stuck in time. These rarely form, only forming once every 40,000,000 [[OYC]] in the obamaverse, but they form more in the obama field. Don't worry about the sentient, sapient obama particles. They stop being conscious in the collision.

===The String===
The String connect particles in the obamaverse and obama field together, and are infinitely thin. Despite this, they are stronger than 99% of verse shells (transfinite verses).

===Flats===
Flats are funny rings that form around clusters of obama particles. They spin at <math>\varepsilon_{\omega+1}</math> RPVS(rounds per void second). These have a strange property of changing positions of entities, but only certain entities. How the position is determined depends on a whole bunch of things.

===Cardae ===
Cardae are polyhedra that form out of concentrated obama particles. They can be used to generate vast quantities of power.

== Life==
The life here is a ton. 100% of the planets, stars, and other objects have life on them. This life is extremely loyal to Obama, and they worship him as a god.  This life isn't omnipotent, but they are quite powerful. They are known as the Obamians. Obamians typically look like obama crystals but often have limbs and are composed largely of obamium and obama related elements that form their cells. The composition of these cells is varied. Most are composed of O-DNA, which is like DNA, but based on obamium or obamogen / obamyxilum. Obamians are some of the most advanced lifeforms, being even more advanced than the [[The Perfect Imperium|Perfect Imperium.]] Most technology in the obamaverse is based on obama elements such as obamium because it is really versatile and is also infinite. As of now, the obamians are banned from the [[Local Universal Alliance|LUA]] due to safety reasons, but both groups have friendly relationships with each other.

==Others==
There used to be more verses like the obamaverse such as the bushverse and the trumpverse,  and even a  bidenverse but the obama field expanded so much that those other verses got sucked into the obamaverse in ~3 [[OYC]]. Only the kennedyverse and the washingtonverse remain, but they are in a collision course with the obamaverse in 2 and 6 OYC respectively.

==Obama Field==
The obama field is a name given to the extent of "excreted" obamium particles which form out of themselves and other particles as well as from nothing. This is not of much importance and is only considered by some to be part of the obamaverse. The obama field's particles on its exterior are attracted to all matter outside of the field, and if they are close enough to it, will stick to it, but only if it is a verse shell<ref>A verse shell is a solid exterior of a verse.</ref>. Parts of the obama field are spinning around the obamaverse in different directions, and others are staying pretty much still. This is confusing but LUA scientists are working on the Obama theory, which will explain the behaviour of obamium.

=="self(-)containment"==
In every most basic particle in the obamaverse is another, smaller copy of the obamaverse. This nests forever. There is no more reason to continue this section, because it is really that simple. The same infinite nestation also exists in every particle that isn't the most basic.

==Seyenovovysk==
Seyenovovysk is a very weird abstract concept existing in the obama field that causes realities (verses with transfinite EUSI or 0 EUSI that have an existence rank that is an integer >0) to form infinite copies of themselves existing in a singularity that are not different in the actual objects themselves existing but have slightly different physical laws, contained by every axion in the obama field as a small copy that just has smaller size, somehow, but manages to have its properties and other things in perfect "detail". It is similar to chiroglovysk in that it effects realities and exists in a self containing singularity as well as an intangible object that can have influences on things outside of itself or its containing verse. Seyenovovysk has influences on other basic particles (smaller than blueprint particles) that changes the laws they conform to. It has no effects on the obama field or obamaverse but it can have effects on the particles existing in other verses. It is unknown if it has any effects on [[Ontological Museum|Ontological Museums]]. Seyenovovysk has a very large gravity well that can pull in external objects (ones that formed outside of the obama field and obamaverse) and send them into the altered verses. Every layer of seyenovovysk has more heavily altered realities and eventually the objects in them stop being the same (likely at layer <math>\omega_2</math>), often resulting in every atom being split and causing another universe to form or something.

== Obama Entities Below ==
Obama Entities will almost always be below this sign.

==Obamiel==
Obamiel is an ancient god that looks like [https://evangelion.fandom.com/wiki/Sixth_Angel Ramiel], but brown and obama. It is capable of manipulating all obamium related elements and particles to change both itself and the things around it. Because of this, it is able to phase through solid matter and do almost anything, but really only in the obamaverse and obama field. You may now be thinking to yourself: "but how powerful is it?" well since it can manipulate obamium in any way it is High [[Absolute God]] level in the obamaverse, and slightly weaker in the obama field. It is only 657,483,236 [[Vsaue]] outside of the obamaverse. Obamiel is also obviously very smart since it can manipulate itself with obamium, so it is omniscient because of course it is.

==Gar-Obama==
Gar-Obama is a mysterious entity that lives in the Obama Field, and it seems to be a producer of obamium structures, as wherever it goes it leaves behind large [[Multiversal Planet|Multiversal Planets]] made entirely of elements in the obamium family. Gar-Obama also turns verses into obamium. It is about as powerful as everything in the 137th [[Everything Layer]] and below, combined. Its appearance is constantly changing, but its most common form is a spinning red-orange obama sphere. It is unknown what gar-obama's gender is, if it even has one. Gar-Obama has only been seen twice by lower entities.

==Gutga ==
Gutga is sittin' there. He has 60,000,000,000,000 [[Vsaue]].

==Barack Obama ==
Barack Obama is the god of the obamaverse. It is unknown how powerful he actually is. He created the obamaverse a long time ago, and still controls it. He lives in the singularity at the center of the obamaverse. Every single thing that has tried to interact, study or observe him has died due to his laser eyes, so it is unknown what he is.

The '''''Obama-[[Metaverse|Metaverses]]''''' were the biggest and the last out of the [[:Category:Obama|Obamaverse]] [[:Category:Chain|chain]] before the existence (creation) of the [[Obama-Xenoverse|Obama xenoverses]] and [[Obama-Megaverse|megaverses]]. It is orange/red due to the extreme abundance of Obamium-171 and Obamium-178 isotopes in the first layer, which are orange/red in gas form and are emitted by many dwarf obama stars.

The '''''Omnionion''''' is a natural structural container with a system of layers. It is the inverse of the [[Voidonion]], which is element-based instead of reality-based.

Each layer is an extended reality building on top of the previous layer, with limit ordinals additionally building on top of the properties of their fundamental sequences.

==Substructures==
Define <math>\odot_{x}</math> as the x-th layer of the Omnionion. 

<math>\odot_{0}</math> is the "traditional" reality, with a mostly static containment order, very basic logic to determine if something is valid, and so on.

For elements in y's fundamental sequence, <math>\odot_{x}</math> generally consists of progressively looser and looser rules applied to the corresponding layer of the Omnionion, along with sub-fundamental-sequence layer correspondences. 

Due to the arbitrary and broad definitions above, the layers of Omnionions are varied in descriptions.
===Naming system===
Each layer is suffixed with ''-skerse'', which itself is named after a combination of the words "skin" and [[Verse]].

=== Universe Clusters ===
Rarely, some universes with almost identical laws can be packed up to form [[Terminal Sphere]]s by a multiversal gravity force. Those spheres are now called Poosda Spheres, named after a youth theoretical physicist Sakis Poosda<ref>A fictional person.</ref>, who proved that spheres consisting with at least 12 Universes never form in our multiverse.

Due to overlapping forces (see [[Our Multiverse#Darismuth's System|Darismuth's System]]), Poosda Spheres have stronger and greater capture clouds, but could mostly hold 8 - 11 Parallel Universes. Those forces caused the center universe to inflate.

All Poosda Spheres usefully become new Darismuth's Systems, when one universe inflates to a size of 300 billion light years. Then, other universes pushed out by the heavy forces from that Universe, although they will become Öonkem Universes thanks to the sudden change of capture clouds for the formation of that system.

[[Small universe cluster]]s never form in our multiverse, also proven by Sakis Poosda.

==In comparison to other neighboring Multiverses==
[[File:Metaverse Multiverse.png|thumb|210x210px|A simplistic image showing how much different the laws of neighboring Multiverses are compared to ours (in the middle). Numbers are only percentage approximates, since laws can't be simply interpreted using 1 number.]]

Multiverses in a Metaverse have different, but usually similar sets of laws. As one gets further away, the laws gradually become more and more different. This is not done in any pattern and this point of focus can be applies to any Multiverse in a Metaverse, whilst still retaining everything said above.

Multiverses closest to us have laws which are very difficult to discern from ours, but it becomes easier once one looks at the finer details of the quantum world. Multiverses further than that will display differences not visible easily, but ones which have larger consequences down the line (for example: Bodhea. Practically the same laws, but long time events happen much more differently). Even further than that, around midway between the edge of our Metaverse and our Multiverse, can be seen the what the general public would identify as, and envision as, different laws. By the edge of the Metaverse, one can potentially even find concepts one has never thought of before.

==History==
===The Xenonatic Bent (5.05 octillion OYC)===
<big>(See also: [[Metaverse|Metaverse Formation]])</big>

Before our Multiverse was formed, [[our Metaverse]] didn't even exist due to their simultaneous formations 20.641 billion years ago, a small portion from [[Xenoverse|the Xenoverse]]'s surface began to bend.

Until trillions of years later, this portion kept bending more and more. Eventually, it was bending so much, that it started to cross itself, causing loops to form. Those loops grew bigger and became primordial [[Metaverse]]s, forming a lot of Multiverses at the same time, including ours. Eventually, quadrillions of universes were formed, which frequently came together and formed [[Our Multiverse#Universe Clusters|Poosda Sphere]]s.

===The Maxxis Hypereon (5.05 octillion OYC - 1.93 octillion OYC)===
Before the Maxxis Hypereon began, our Multiverse was a crossing point from [[our Metaverse]]. This began 5.05 octillion OYC ago, when chaotic particles collided with singularities, causing an explosion of gigantic universes. Those universes weren't stable enough, as virtual particles always collided with other universes due to the borders being really close to each other.

Dark energy and [[Imaginary Energy]] fueled those universes up, causing them to expand to billions, trillions or even quadrillions of light-years across! Unfortunately, almost all of those universes went through a [[Big Freeze]] scenario, reducing the amount from quadrillions to just hundreds of millions.

Those trigintillions (10<sup>93</sup>) of slow chaotic particles are now stuck in at eternity. Most laws from our nearest Multiverse was stuck there too, but then completely written in upcoming universes. There are billions of universes remain in a void, and won't happen until 1.93 octillion OYC, due to a really low presence of [[Imaginary Energy]] during this hypereon.

1.93 octillion OYC ago, a gravitational singularity boom occurred, creating millions of new universes. That is a significant timeframe that ends this Hypereon.

===The Poosda Hypereon (1.93 octillion OYC - 623 septillion OYC)===
The Poosda Hypereon began with a cluster of a lot of universes and many [[Our Multiverse#Universe Clusters|Poosda Spheres]]s. Many universes suddenly entered the majority of Poosda Spheres during that time. Nothing happened until around 1.321 octillion OYC ago, when the centers started to inflate due to the excess of dark energy. This hypereon ended 623 septillion OYC ago, when all Poosda Spheres turned into [[Our Multiverse#Darismuth's System|Darismuth's System]]s.

===The Darismuth Hypereon (623 septillion OYC - present)===
The Darismuth Hypereon is currently the ongoing hypereon.

'''''Picoverse''''' is a type of verse contained by [[Nanoverse|Nanoverses]]. Like the formers, they're 2-dimensional, meaning that 3D and higher dimensional objects can't '''''entirely''''' enter or interact with these verses.

==Structures==
Picoverses, like [[Universe|Universes]], contain star system groups, but they're not big enough to contain at least one [[galaxy]]. All structures inside a Picoverse are 2D, like a Nanoverse's structures. 2D [[Star|stars]], [[Solar System|star systems]] and [[Planet|planets]] exist here.

==Picoverse collisions==
Picoverses, like Universes, can collide with eachother forming and/or destroying other Picoverses.

*Soft Collisions (0.1 LY - 1 LY per second) - They form a new Picoverse. Picoverses that participated in the collision will get bounced out from it, sometimes even from it's local Nanoverse.
*Hard Collisions (1 LY - 10 LY per second) - They can't form a new Picoverse, they'll only get bounced off or destroyed.
*Intense Collisions (10 LY - 100 LY per second) - They destroy the Picoverses that form part in the collision.
* Hyper Collisions (>100 LY per second) - Same as the former, but they can also affect nearby Picoverses in the worst case scenario.

== About ==
A '''''point''''' is a location of size zero. This means a point is not a region, but a single location.

It is defined by Euler as "that which has no part", which is an apt description - a point has no height, width, depth, or any other measure in any other dimension.

It is also the only zero-dimensional shape, and any zero-dimensional space consists of a single point and nothing else. This means that it can be considered  as a zero-dimesional space of infinite extent, in analogue with the [[plane]].

A line can be thought of as consisting of an infinite amount of points placed directly adjacent to each other. 

By the same logic, a plane can be thought of as infinity lines being stacked next to each other.

== About ==
The '''Quasiverses''' are verses that are found inside of the [[Omniverse|Omniverses]]. They contain lots of [[Hyperverse|Hyperverses]] and sometimes even [[Xenoverse|Xenoverses]]. Because they occupy a bottleneck position right before the absolute edge of reality, they function as massive high-dimensional cushions. Without their presence, the intense reality-warping pressures of the true Omniverses would instantly crush smaller multi-universal structures.

They are the second largest type of [[Archverse]]. In the grand scaling of the '''[[:Category:1st-class|first]] [[:Category:Class|class]]''', their physical size is practically unfathomable, expanding from a baseline minimum of '''Graatagold''' Light Years to a maximum boundless expansion of '''Goxxol''' Light Years. Due to this colossal scale, their internal energy matrix is rated between Type Gugold and Type G15 on the expanded Kardashev scale, allowing them to easily anchor infinite lower planes within their borders.

''Main article: [[Quasiverse/Anatomy]]'' 

== Shape & Structure ==
The '''Quasiverses''' have a weird shape. Unlike ordinary spherical universes, they have a core with '''golden spirals, group regions, and Hyperverse Radiation Areas'''.

=== The Core ===
The '''core''' operates on a complex dimensional framework that ranges from '''Tritri'''<ref name=":0" /> '''to''' '''{10, 10, 2, 2} Dimensions'''. The golden spirals spinning around this core are actually visible geometric projections of multi-dimensional '''energy currents'''. These currents flow through the dense hyperspace, stabilizing the ambient temperature at '''Around 1 Micrillion C°''' due to the constant dimensional friction of the realities inside. There can be found rare instances of Hyperverses and Xenoverses, these are the most hot being at '''Around''' '''1 Micri-millillion C°'''.

=== The Group Regions ===
Surrounding the core are the group regions (that look like galaxies). These regions act as clusters where trillions of 7D Hyperverses float safely like suspended membranes, the average temperature there is '''278.357 Octoquinquagintaducentillion C°''' (coincidentally it is 10<sup>777</sup> in the short scale).
=== The Hyperverse Radiation Areas ===
These are turquoise regions that have Hyperverses which are '''expelled from Group Regions'''. These are the ones consuming their Quasiverse and give it a lifetime which is around '''{5, 3, 4} years''' for the average Quasiverse. Ours has only around '''{1512, 735, 3} years left'''.

When a Hyperverse becomes unstable within its original '''Group Region''', it undergoes a process called ''Cosmic Rejection'' and is violently cast out into these hazardous outer zones. Once trapped in the Hyperverse Radiation Areas, these Hyperverses slowly '''escape from their Quasiverse''', consuming its size until these Hyperverse Radiation Areas '''float in the Omniverses'''.

This internal consumption creates a strict cosmic countdown. It limits the lifespan of an average Quasiverse to '''{5, 3, 4} years''' in [[w:c:googology:Array_notation|Array notation]]. Because Our Quasiverse has been existing for so long, it has already been severely degraded. Current cosmic calculations indicate that our home structure is facing imminent collapse, with only around '''{1512, 735, 3} years left''' before it completely dissolves into the absolute [[void]] of the Omniverses. With these obsolete Hyperverses, '''new Quasiverses form'''.

[[File:Our Hyperverse in Our Quasiverse.png|thumb|'''Our Hyperverse in Our Quasiverse''']]

== Our location in our Quasiverse ==
Our Hyperverse is around '''Spiral - 1A62E48''', on group region '''46702F295D'''

== Its relation with Extended Divergent Archverses ==
The [[Extended Divergent Archverses]] are contained in the '''Quasiverse''', it is the ω-th archverse in the chain. 

While '''lower archverses in Class 1''' are bound by standard finite numbers (like the #13 Tredaverse or the #20 Ikaverse), the Quasiverse completely breaks the sequence by occupying the first transfinite ordinal slot. As the '''ultimate boundary''' layer of the Starter Class.

=== Why it is the ω-th archverse ===
The Extended Divergent Archverses's '''scale''' grows almost infinitely, but their [[Dimension]]ality grows logarithmically, this happens so all Extended Divergent Archverses can fit inside.

Because their spatial axes experience a severe '''logarithmic deceleration''' as they approach the Omega boundary, even the highest numerical archverses are mathematically bottlenecked. They can expand across vast amounts of physical light years, but they lack the higher dimensional freedom to break out of the pre-omniversal matrix. On the other hand, the Quasiverse operates natively on a supreme grid of '''Tritri to {10, 10, 2, 2} Dimensions'''. This massive gap in dimensional complexity '''creates an infinite hyper-volume''', ensuring that the sprawling, near-infinite '''scale of all''' Extended Divergent Archverses can be '''perfectly nested''' and contained around the currents of our local golden spirals.

=== Their density in the Quasiverse ===
You will not see many Archverses past the Hyperverses in the Quasiverses, their '''density''' shrinks relative to the Archverse, the density of the [[Udekaverse]] for example is only around '''5.87 * 10<sup>-34,139,452</sup>%''' Udekaverses in the average Quasiverse, in ours the density is around '''1.40 * 10<sup>-36,179,194</sup>%''' Udekaverses.

This extreme scarcity is a direct consequence of the '''logarithmic dimensionality''' of the Extended Divergent Archverses. Because their spatial axes are bottlenecked while their physical scale expands nearly infinitely, they require massive amounts of hyper-volume just to anchor themselves within the Quasiverse's matrix. They do not cluster together like normal universes. Instead, they are '''scattered across the vast vacuum''', making them an exceptionally rare anomaly. In Our Quasiverse, the density drops even lower to '''1.40 * 10<sup>-36,179,194</sup>%''' because the ongoing Hyperverse Radiation process has been constantly shrinking our total volume, leaving almost no room for massive structures like the Udekaverse to remain within our borders.

[[File:Quasiverse Life Cycle.png|left|400px|thumb|The life cycle as image]]

== Quasiverses's life cycle ==
The '''life cycle of a Quasiverse''' is a precise, high-dimensional process that dictates how these structures evolve and eventually return to the greater cosmos. Their existence spans through four main developmental phases:

=== Birth ===
A Quasiverse begins its life cycle when '''multiple Archverses''' (mainly Hyperverses because of '''Hyperverse Radiation''') come together. This immense pressure triggers a dimensional expansion, unfolding the core into this '''thick soup of Archverses''' (as seen in the image). This thick soup eventually finds the pattern of the '''Golden Spirals''', this is why they are the '''hottest part''' in their Quasiverse, there are more Archverses there so there is more heat. The '''Group Regions''' form around '''10<sup>1,689,392,103</sup> years later''' because of the chaos in the spirals, the density of Archverses there is so large that they had to be expelled outward, because of gravity they joined into the Group Regions.

=== Peak ===
The Quasiverse gains '''its peak in size''', more and more Archverses come '''join the Quasiverse''' because of gravity, they also gain more dimensions when there is a '''very dense clustering of Archverses''' again. But over extended eons, some '''Group Regions become dense''', so they expell certain Archverses into the Omniverse. Now it '''is harmless''', but this is marking the transition into the most '''volatile period''' of the Quasiverse's life cycle.

=== Decline ===
Once the rejected Hyperverses are trapped in the '''outer boundaries''', the '''Hyperverse Radiation''' phenomenon begins. As they exit, they literally radiate outward like cosmic particles, consuming the total size and volume of the host Quasiverse. The '''average lifespan''' for a standard structure during this shrinking phase is '''around {4.8, 3, 4} years''' in Bowers' notation. Our Quasiverse is currently deep within this terminal stage, severely degraded with '''only around {1512, 735, 3} years left'''.

=== Death ===
The final phase occurs when the Hyperverse Radiation Areas have '''leaked''' so many Archverses that the remaining structure can '''no longer be considered a "Quasiverse"''', this happens because the '''number of dimensions and size shrinks enough'''. The remaining Hyperverse Radiation Areas detach entirely from the core, floating away as isolated remnants into the absolute infinity of the true Omniverse. This marks the total completion of the Quasiverse's life cycle, but with these floating Archverses '''new Quasiverses form'''.

The only realm that we can comprehend beyond Realm 13 is Realm <math>\aleph_0</math>(known as The White Realm), the physical benchmark when it comes to realms. We are only aware of its existence through [[The Perfect Imperium]] and their texts. Absolutely nothing known can breach realm Aleph-Null and as such, it is unknown what lies beyond it. What we do know, however, is that Realm <math>\aleph_0</math>is insanely large and old.

Due to the age of The Perfect Imperium (300,000 [[OYC]]), for which the realm was created, the age can be expressed through this following formula, with Theta being the sum of the age of all inferior realms: <math>\aleph0 = G(300,000(\theta))</math>. == About ==
'''''Randomuser66's Space Bottles''''', also known as ''Space Bottles'', are the containment of the [[Beeg Cluster|Beeg Clusters]]. They're similar to the [[The Bottle|Bottles]], but on a much, MUCH larger scale.

Space Bottles are necessary for space-time to continue inside them, so breaking their glass is no option, since if the glass was broken, it would rebuild itself due to space-time laws.

== Name origins ==
They received their name after the [[Transcendent Omni-God|TOG]] known as [[User:Randomuser66|Randomuser66]] decided to name these after him, while also basing off the already known Bottles.

== Exiting a Space Bottle ==
The only way to exit these bottles is through their neck, which is a very small part of them, but since there is no lid it is easy to escape through there.

== Liquid contents ==
Just like normal bottles, Space Bottles are capable of containing liquids inside their hollow structure.

Most Space Bottles have blue beer inside of them, which suprisingly can naturally evaporate and/or solidify. The beer is also always found at the bottom due to the size change in the gas stage.

A fewer amount of them contain water instead, though adding large amounts of components to that sustance will make those Space Bottles turn into the more common beer-filled ones.

The convex hull of any nonempty subset of the n + 1 points that define an n-simplex is called a face of the simplex. Faces are simplices themselves. In particular, the convex hull of a subset of size m + 1 (of the n + 1 defining points) is an m-simplex, called an m-face of the n-simplex. The 0-faces (i.e., the defining points themselves as sets of size 1) are called the vertices (singular: vertex), the 1-faces are called the edges, the (n − 1)-faces are called the facets, and the sole n-face is the whole n-simplex itself. In general, the number of m-faces is equal to the binomial coefficient (n+1 m+1). The elements of a simplex are simplexes themselves. The amounts of subfacets follow Pascals triangle.

An n-simplex is the polytope with the fewest vertices that requires n dimensions. An n-simplex is the polytope with the fewest vertices that requires n dimensions. Consider a line segment AB as a shape in a 1-dimensional space (the 1-dimensional space is the line in which the segment lies). One can place a new point C somewhere off the line. The new shape, triangle ABC, requires two dimensions; it cannot fit in the original 1-dimensional space. The triangle is the 2-simplex, a simple shape that requires two dimensions. Consider a triangle ABC, a shape in a 2-dimensional space (the plane in which the triangle resides). One can place a new point D somewhere off the plane. The new shape, tetrahedron ABCD, requires three dimensions; it cannot fit in the original 2-dimensional space. The tetrahedron is the 3-simplex, a simple shape that requires three dimensions. Consider tetrahedron ABCD, a shape in a 3-dimensional space (the 3-space in which the tetrahedron lies). One can place a new point E somewhere outside the 3-space. The new shape ABCDE, called a 5-cell, requires four dimensions and is called the 4-simplex; it cannot fit in the original 3-dimensional space. (It also cannot be visualized easily.) This idea can be generalized, that is, adding a single new point outside the currently occupied space, which requires going to the next higher dimension to hold the new shape. This idea can also be worked backward: the line segment we started with is a simple shape that requires a 1-dimensional space to hold it; the line segment is the 1-simplex. The line segment itself was formed by starting with a single point in 0-dimensional space (this initial point is the 0-simplex) and adding a second point, which required the increase to 1-dimensional space.
