== About ==
A '''Yourmomverse''' is a [[verse]] that contains every possible variant of your mother at any point in time. As a result, it is 11 dimensional, and ginormous.  

== States ==
This type of verse has three states.  

#The first one is when the verse is shaped like a small cube. This has only happened once; before moms even existed. It is likely to have stopped existing immediately after the [[The First Boom|First Boom]] that generated it.
# The second state is the current state most Yourmomverses are undergoing, aka looking like the absolute mean of all variants of your mother at once, but upscaled by an uncountably infinite amount in size. This is the state these verses are likely to be in for the rest of their time. This is their most unstable state too.
#This third state is completely hypothetical, but it is likely to happen when all variations of moms in a Youmomverse die out (including the immortal ones). It is likely to be in a shape similar to the first state, but upscaled in size and dimensionality by [[Cantor's Absolute Infinity|Ω]]. However, since there are no mothers left, the cube won't even move anymore, and is likely to become the most stable type of verse in existence.

==Timeline==
Yourmomverses have existed for an unknown amount of time, since there have always been moms. However, it is likely that it has existed since their First Boom, aka their first ever big bang. These verses have then been growing ever since. At first, they only had every 4D counterpart of your mother, aka your mother in every point of time. Now all of them are 11 dimensional, at least. As a result, these verses are technically omnipresent, as they exist in every point of time, space, etc. This does NOT mean they're the biggest type of verse, though. 
==Interesting Variations of Your Mother==
There have been many variations of your mother throughout the past few years/decades. Here's some of the most common and interesting ones.
=== The Normal Mother===
{{Cosmic_entity|title1 = Normal Mother|image1 = [[File:Mother.jpg]]|caption1 = The most common appearance of a Mother.|rules_over = Varies|age = Varies|size = Varies|knowledge = Anywhere from 2 to 713 IQ|power = Varies|goals = Varies|species = Mother/Human}}
==== About ====
The ''normal mothers'' are not special at all, as they're the most common type of mother, taking up more than an entire ~1.428% of the mom population in the Yourmomverses.

==== Intellect ====
They usually have normal intellect, but a few normal mothers very rarely have an absurdly high IQ<ref>Intelligence Quotient, usually used as a measure of a person's smartness</ref>, due to probability in parallel universes varying heavily. The same also applies to absurdly low IQs.

==== Environmental prescence ====
All normal mothers live in a typical environment, some being unlucky and living in less quality environments. Around a third of these mothers are of higher than average weight (of their specific universe).

===The Batmother ===
{{Cosmic_entity|title1 = Batmother|image1 = [[File:Batmom.jpg]]|caption1 = The most common appearance of a Batmother.|rules_over = The Caves of the Yourmomverse|age = Anywhere from 22 to 8,500|size = Anywhere from 0.2 to 5 meters tall, and anywhere from 0.1 to 2 meters wide.|knowledge = Anywhere from 10 to 115 IQ|power = Varies|goals = Varies|species = Bat/Mother}}
==== About ====
The ''Batmothers'' take up around 0.002% of the mom population in the average Yourmomverse. All forms of batmothers can fly, and it is in fact one of their main gimmicks.

==== Diet ====
their diet consists of either purely fruits or even other mothers, though the latter only occurs in very rare cases in which the Batmothers are starving to death, thus undergoing a mental process where they become feral and are even willing to commit cannibalism just to avoid death.

==== Habitats ====
They usually live in caves, and don't usually attack unless absolutely necessary or, like mentioned before, are staving to death.

==== Trivia ====

Their power ranges from [[Galaxy|galactic]]-level to being able to destroy [[:Category:7th-class|7th-]][[:Category:Class|class]] verses, like [[So|Sos]].

''The '''Zowyn''' are a type of [[:Category:Cosmic entity|entity]] from the [[The Second Realm|Second Realms]].''

''Zowyn behavioral patterns vary. They are typically calm and composed however, on rare occasions, they show extreme anger. During these times, they will attack all visible forms of life, sparing only others of their own kind. Although they are usually calm and composed toward humans, they show hostility toward all other Second Realm entities.''

== ''Sightings and Interactions'' ==
''In the Second Realm that [[Human|we]] inhabit, Zowyns have been spotted 586 times. However, of the times it has visited us, only 154 were in its angered state, during which it caused around 71 Octogintillion dimensions to be destroyed on average, and around 678549586241233059450 comic entities dying tried to save themselves. They remain in our realm for varying durations, ranging from 0.001 Planck times to approximately a day and a half. Its most destructive attack occurred in the 86th year of the Omniversal Calendar, during which it destroyed approximately a duooctogintillion dimensions.''

== '''Logs of ''Zowyns''''' ==
''Logs describe Zowyns rushing toward Vowoez and easily shattering their bodies. [[Vowoez]] then attempted to attack their assailants, but to no avail, as they too were shattered. On many occasions, they have been observed attempting to attack [[the Ealer]], only to be destroyed by a uncountably infinite amount of Vowoez. Also they have been seen attacking [[Yetmmud|Yetmmuds]], and absolutely destroying them with no remorse in the slightest. Though it has been recorded that they are hostile toward nearly all Second Realm beings, they are not hostile toward the Rchtimayy, with whom they have an alliance with. The Rchtimayy construct structures  for the Zowyns, while the Zowyns protect them from other, more powerful Second Realm creatures in return.''

⬤, the building block of mathematical and physical logic, has been an object ever since the first [[·|·s]] collided. Typically, it is naturally/artificially used to generate/define properties, or (rarely) to bloat an object with unnecessary properties to prevent detection of paradoxes like ·. 

Most of ⬤'s properties are hidden away, so that only one property is set/created to prevent contradictions, which can lead into · forming.

==Reactions==
* ⬤s colliding with [[Blueprint Particle|Blueprint Particles]] lead to the same result of the collision of · and Blueprint Particles, expect for Function Structures.
* ⬤s are used as one of the inputs for [[Blueprint Particle#Function|Function Structures]].
* ⬤s are always leaving the swarm of Blueprint Particles behind expect the property and function ones, just to prevent the forces from colliding it.
* ⬤s colliding with Property Forces lead to the destruction of themselves, leaving ·s and ○s remain from the swarm of Blueprint Particles.

==Structure==
The vast majority of ⬤ is a void consisting of [[○|○s]], which are the wrappers around · that prevent dangerous paradoxes from escaping or affecting any objects. The void consisting of ○ is due to reasons listed in the last sentence, as well as the fact that the · within has 0 properties. This is useful to prevent ⬤ from clogging up with many more properties than it already has.

==Formation process==
===Phase 0===
Phase 0 is the "preparation" phase for ⬤ production. This usually involves ·s colliding with each other with the end goal of having an · be embedded in another ·, although direct insertion is more reliable.

'''End Result:''' A structure of ·s within ·s

===Phase 1===
Due to the structure of the targeted · from the previous step, each · will repel the other one due to the nature of paradoxes. Eventually, the outer · will become infinitely huge (relative to its original size), while the inner · will become infinitely small.

'''End Result:''' A structure of ·s within ·s, but the outer one is increased in size infinite-fold, while the inner one is decreased in size infinite-fold

===Phase 2===
Extreme pressure will cause the inner · to collapse into two parts: one being containing the forces of the former ·, while the other containing the "mass" of the former ·. As a force is useless without being attached to any object, it will become a "blank force" that overrides any forces that come through it. This causes ○ to form.

'''End Result:''' A infinite times bigger · containing an ○

===Phase 3===
The · and ○s will now "reproduce" and populate the to-be ⬤. However, the paradoxes will get overridden, leaving "property forces" that progressively get stronger and stronger.

Eventually, there will be enough property forces that the binding force between said forces will be strong, causing a single property to be projected onto the new ⬤.

'''End Result:''' A ⬤

==Formation of Blueprint Particles==
Later, escaping property forces transformed a lot of ·s to produce the first [[Blueprint Particle#Property|Property Blueprint Particles]]. Other forces transformed ·s into some [[Blueprint Particle#Function|Function Blueprint Particles]]. They also brought ⬤s into [[Blueprint Particle#Function|Function Structures]] to complete the whole definition of [[Blueprint Particle|Blueprint Particles]] (Wave, Force, Property, and Fabric), which allows those particles to make up our [[Reality]].

Eventually, ⬤s will disappear from the swarm. A lot of ⬤s remain, just about 1 of 100 Blueprint Particles are ⬤s, but they are now used for one of the primary inputs of Function Structures. Unfortunately, many other ⬤s has been obliterated, which make the chaotic chain reaction between ·s and ⬤s.

Fortunately, all ⬤s from all Inanes aren't scared due to the "nothingness" property of Inane.


Million of [[OYC|OYD]]s after the formation of Blueprint Particles, all ·s and ⬤s will be fully transformed.

===Collisions with phases 1 - 2===
Phases 1 and 2 have a interesting collision, as ·s have so much pressure that it could dissolve particles quickly.

When · collides with developing ·s, · will become bigger than those ·s. When Phase 2 is done, 2 biggest ·s will become ○s, in which one ○ contains another ○. Those ○s will become infinite amount of ⬤s within a bigger ⬤, and then ⬤s will be put in a special kind of subreality called [[Perareality]].

If ⬤ collides with developing ·s, extreme pressure would cause dot particles in that ⬤s will be pulled into a rift, in which they will land in a Perareality developed by those ·s.
